title: Rejoice The Lord is King
lyrics_original: Rejoice, the Lord is King! Your Lord and King adore;
Rejoice, give thanks and sing, and triumph evermore;
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
Rejoice, again I say, rejoice!
Jesus, the Savior, reigns, the God of truth and love;
When He had purged our stains He took His seat above;
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
Rejoice, again I say, rejoice!
His kingdom cannot fail, He rules o'er earth and Heav'n,
The keys of death and hell are to our Jesus giv'n;
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
Rejoice, again I say, rejoice!
He sits at God's right hand till all His foes submit,
And bow to His command, and fall beneath His feet:
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice;
Rejoice, again I say, rejoice!
He all His foes shall crush, shall all our sins destroy,
And every saint shall rush with pure unending joy;
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice,
Rejoice, again I say, rejoice!
Rejoice in glorious hope! Jesus the Judge shall come,
And take His servants up to their eternal home.
We soon shall hear th'archangel's voice;
The trump of God shall sound, rejoice!

bible_verses.english: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord God, the Almighty, reigns!”

His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself made purification for our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I rejoice today knowing that You reign over all creation and hold my life safely in Your hands. Thank You for purifying my heart and defeating sin and death forever. When worries try to steal my peace, lift my eyes to Your heavenly throne. Teach me to walk in the triumphant joy of Your unstoppable kingdom. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: In a world filled with shifting uncertainties, this joyful hymn anchors our hearts in an unchanging truth: Jesus is King. Having cleansed our sins and conquered death, He reigns in perfect love and truth from His throne above. No matter what trials we face today, His kingdom cannot fail. As we lift our voices and hearts to Him, we are invited to rest in His sovereign care and rejoice with boundless hope.
